haiku.problem: The passage says both His salvation (51:6) and His righteousness (51:8) will last forever, so 'What will last forever?' has two correct answers in the passage. The right answer 'His salvation' is still correct, but a baker could argue for 'His righteousness,' which isn't among the options. The question needs to name the salvation the heavens-and-earth verse is about, as the original card did.
